topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I can’t believe this, I just found out you’ve been writing a novel about me? Like, didn’t you think I’d want to know about this? I mean, really, using my life, my experiences, for your story without even a heads-up? I feel so exposed, like everything I’ve told you, every trust I’ve placed in you, is sprawled out there for whoever wants to read it. It’s like you’ve been keeping this huge secret, and I’m supposed to be okay with it? I can’t even process how much I don’t like this. We need to talk, and we need to talk now.
